text_block_list.text: During a break on a day midway through summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That circuit training earlier... went really well.
Could it be that I've gotten a little stronger...? Hehe, just maybe.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, looks like they're about to run!
Let's go watch, hurry!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You were really looking forward to it, weren't you~?
Saying how it looks so much like your big sister and all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, about what was just said...—

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-cha~n! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Okaay♡

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sooo cute, seriously~!
Look, such slender legs, and huge eyes!

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely come cheer for you!
I can't wait for your debut!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm getting so much attention!
Making a debut really is a big deal after all~♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —All right! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It really is Vivlos.
Huh, she's working hard...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aww, she really looks
just like Verxina-san! Super cute!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
They said she's debuting in the fall.
Just like with Verxina, I'm definitely
going to be there to cheer her on~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, didn't she have another younger sister?
Did you not check on her?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because it suits Vivlos-chan better.
Ah~ I really want to see the two sisters standing side by side~

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (――Vivlos over me... huh. Well, that's nothing new, but...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(She's always stood out, ever since back then...
Even before her debut, people are already talking about her like this...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a big sigh!
—Are you really that worried about your little sister?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Crown-san?
N-No, you've got it wrong, that was just—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-I guess Vivlos and I really
aren't alike at all... after all."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That might be true.
Aren't you super lucky♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
? But you know where you're not similar, right?
I think that's a very good thing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... what do you mean by—?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Comparing yourself to others—meaning social comparison—
is basically just a tool for self-awareness, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...And so. Hey, look!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "Together with Crown-san leading the way, we must devote ourselves even further so the Satono family may contribute to the racing world—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: This is footage from the debut celebration party we held at the Satono household the other day for Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: She's also having her Make Debut this autumn, just like your little sister—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Can you hear them? The voices of the older gentlemen around us.

text_block_list.name: Guests
text_block_list.text:
"The Satono treasures have finally arrived."
"Now, which of them will achieve greater results—"

text_block_list.name: Guests
text_block_list.text:
"We need both of them to do their best..."
"With those girls, domestic G1s and overseas races are..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, people are saying all sorts of things, right?
Of course, I know they're cheering me on, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You see, Dia is like a little sister to me.
That's why we've always been compared to each other.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Close in age, gifted with running talent,
both expected to shine in the Twinkle Series
in the same way—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I consider myself incredibly lucky to have her around.
After all, she's an invaluable mirror that reflects who I am.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A mirror...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's right. For example—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Where we're most alike is our finishing drive at the end of a race.
Neither of us knows when to give up, you see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She might be more blessed in terms of physical frame strength.
So the longer the distance, the more advantageous it is for her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, hills and rough tracks are my forte.
I'm confident I won't lose, especially when the odds are stacked against me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Other than that... let's see.
The fur on our tails is somehow identical!
Isn't it funny how something like that matches?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...So, in that sense, you see.
I use her presence as an index to understand myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Getting to know someone else's individuality
is the same as getting to know yourself, right?
That's why I said we were lucky!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...A-Amazing—
To be able to think like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I compare myself to others,
all I can think about is how useless I am...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Oh now. The only reason you get down from comparing yourself
is because you can recognize what makes others amazing, right, Cheval?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You can only do that if you respect your opponent.
I think that's a wonderful quality of yours.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to have respect for yourself, too.
If you do—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Cheval will definitely be able to discover even more amazing qualities within herself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I, to myself...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Right. You have one, don't you?
A "strength" where you outshine everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, not at all!
F-For someone like me to be gifted... or anything like that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why the panic?
You found it long ago.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ……? What did I……?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The remarkable qualities that are yours alone, distinct from your older or younger sisters.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For instance, her long-lasting kick and steady race management.
Not to mention her earnest personality that allows her to steadily build up stamina.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You found that kind of "strength" by comparing yourself to your older sisters.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Efficient and rational.
I've been impressed by how clever she's been ever since her Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: My... 'strength'...
‘You really are different from your older sisters.’
‘You truly are different from your older sisters.’
"Your differences are what make you strong!"
"Those differences are precisely your strength!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It's true, Trainer told me so too.
That I'm suited for long distances...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Wait, is she actually being serious and not just trying to cover for me...?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That's why
I decided to look at you too.
At you—and at myself."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It's my policy never to take my eyes off my rivals, you know?
Which means you're an important mirror for me too♪"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah..., hawa...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………Me, a rival...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(N-No, this is bad...
My head feels all floaty...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Someone like me... really...?)

After returning from the break, Cheval Grand
seemed somewhat absentminded...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Cheval-chaaan.
We're starting training, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Ah, s-sorry, Shine! I kind of spaced out for a second.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "T-That won't do. I have to take things seriously, just like Shine—"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Fufu, come on.
You've always been the serious one,
Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Even back in junior club, you pushed through doing the exact same regimen as me, even though I was older, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I've always respected her, thinking how amazing she is
and how I can't let myself lose to her.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
So, being able to get serious like this
is all thanks to you, Chevalier-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'm always thinking to myself,
"I gotta work hard just like Cheval-chan~."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh..., eeeeek...

I hesitated to throw cold water on their heartwarming conversation,
but we couldn't afford to waste time during our training camp.

"I have a special training partner right now.
I was trying to come up with an interesting routine, and――"
choice_data_list: We're aiming for the summit with piggyback rock-paper-scissors hiking!
Let's reach the summit with a rock-paper-scissors piggyback climb!
Let's play tag... winner gets ice cream!

text_block_list.text:
"I have a special training partner right now.
I was trying to come up with an interesting routine, and――"
choice_data_list: We're aiming for the summit with piggyback rock-paper-scissors hiking!
Let's reach the summit with a rock-paper-scissors piggyback climb!
Let's play tag... winner gets ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... P-Piggyback mountain climbing...?
choice_data_list: Whoever loses at rock-paper-scissors has to carry the other up on their back.
Whoever loses at rock-paper-scissors has to carry the other up on their back.

text_block_list.text:
High-load mountain climbing will surely
build up their power.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Cheval-chan's Trainer is quite an amusing person, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"It looks kind of fun—
Let's go, Cheval-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
――Aah...!
I-It's my loss again...!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Chevalier-chan,
you can't just keep throwing scissors~.
Is that a habit of yours, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Really?
I... I didn't notice...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Alright... next time I'll make sure not to throw scissors—
The sunset view from the mountaintop we finally reached was breathtakingly beautiful—

Running continuously on the sand requires a lot of guts.
However, with a close friend as a rival, it should be an enjoyable challenge.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
It's ice cream, Chevalier-chan!
It's hot out... so it's definitely gonna be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that's only for the winner, right?
...I'm not confident, but I-I have to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, Cheval-chan is so fast...
Wait, wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-If I wait, I'll lose...! I want... ice cream too...!
"And so, as dusk fell, we decided that everyone would share the reward ice cream together—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......Hehe, ...it's delicious...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Well then—good night, Cheval-chan!
Let's do our best again tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah, see you tomor—... wait.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...That's—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... th-th-that Kita-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Cheval-chan.
What's the matter, at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Right back at you, Kita-san...
Don't tell me, are you going to keep running?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! To change my weak self,
I plan to train ruthlessly this summer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry about the other day.
Making you listen to my pathetic whining like that."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
After that, I thought about it.
If I don't want to stay feeling pathetic,
then running really is my only choice...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, thank you for worrying about me back then!
I promise I'll do my very best.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm off--!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (You told me back then that you weren't a positive person, but...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: You really are amazing, Kita-san...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if I can find it too...
A strength all my own, different from yours...)
